definitions: A style of interior design where furniture and furnishings are chosen for their appearance of age and signs of wear and tear, or where new items are distressed to achieve the appearance of an antique.
Relating to or characteristic of the shabby chic style.
examples: She decorated her living room in a shabby chic style.
The store specialized in shabby chic furniture.
They found a beautiful shabby chic dresser at the flea market.
